tools.name: check_email_breaches
tools.description: Check whether an email address appears in the XposedOrNot index of known public data breaches. Returns the list of breach names only. Never returns passwords.

tools.name: get_breach_analytics
tools.description: Get a detailed breach history for one email address: the breaches it appeared in with dates and descriptions, exposure broken down by industry and by year, risk scoring, and any paste exposure. Never returns passwords.

tools.name: list_breaches
tools.description: List breaches in the XposedOrNot catalog, optionally filtered by the breached company domain or by a specific breach ID. Returns breach name, date, industry, record count, categories of data exposed and a reference URL.

tools.name: domain_breach_summary
tools.description: Get an aggregate breach summary for a domain, including the number of breaches, affected email accounts, pastes, and the most recent breach date. Returns only counts, not individual email addresses.

tools.name: get_breach_metrics
tools.description: Get system-wide breach statistics: total breaches and records indexed, breaches per year and industry, the largest and most recent breaches, and when the latest breach was added.

tools.name: get_recent_breaches
tools.description: Get the breaches most recently added to XposedOrNot, newest first. Returns title, date, a short summary and a URL for each.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_email_breaches" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_breaches, get_breach_analytics, list_breaches, domain_breach_summary, get_recent_breaches · Private data: check_email_breaches, get_breach_analytics, list_breaches, get_breach_metrics · Public sink: check_email_breaches, get_breach_analytics, domain_breach_summary.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_breaches, get_breach_analytics, list_breaches, domain_breach_summary, get_recent_breaches · Private data: check_email_breaches, get_breach_analytics, list_breaches, get_breach_metrics · Public sink: check_email_breaches, get_breach_analytics, domain_breach_summary

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
